_comment: Extra LIVE-mode plans, added on top of STRIPE_PLANS_JSON (the live list kept in Render). Read only when STRIPE_PLANS_JSON is set, so test mode never sees these live Price IDs, and never replaces a key that list already has. Price IDs are not secret. Every package can be paid three ways: <package>-full (the whole price up front), <package>-deposit (50% to start; also the first payment of a payment plan) and <package>-final (the other 50% at launch). Payment plan monthly payments are not sold here: each one is emailed to the client as its own Stripe card link. test-payment: a $1 private test of the checkout (Stripe product prod_VbmWv8R1lnHTSR), linked from nowhere on the site; open /checkout/?plan=test-payment, pay, then refund it in the Stripe Dashboard. Delete the entry to switch it off.
